creator: Alexander Terp
description: muster pane clear and the API's pane.clear landed on 2026-11-13 without the window's half: the pane and agent-row context menus have no Clear Context item, the keymap has no bindable clear_pane action, and a pane's record does not say whether its harness can clear, so a menu cannot grey the item out.
title: Clear Context in the window: a menu item, a clear_pane action and a record field saying whether an agent clears
